newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.LANKA STOCKS END LOW ON FALLS IN FINANCE SHARES.
newsitem.headline: S.LANKA STOCKS END LOW ON FALLS IN FINANCE SHARES.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed down on Friday due to falls in two highly capitalised development finance (DFI) shares, brokers said.
The all share index closed 5.9 points down at 850.6. Blue chip DFIs Development Finance (DFCC) fell four rupees to 315, National Development Bank Ltd (NDB) 24 to 275.
"The fall in DFCC is due to profit-taking. But NDB fell as local investors speculated on the price at which the bank would make a public offer," said a broker.
NDB said on Friday it was issuing 16.5 million shares to foreign investors at 260 rupees each and 900,000 shares on the Colombo Stock Exchange, at a discount of 10-15 percent.
